the neural mechanisms of the emotional intelligence-related differences in the processing of emotional facial expressions.
the role of the theta rhythm in processing of emotional stimuli, which is a new approach in the study of emotional intelligence.
the role that theta oscillations play in the emotional evaluation of the stimuli.

emotional intelligence is related to the ability to quickly process the emotional content of facial expression and to the ability to selectively increase positive emotions.

the higher the emotional intelligence of the subject, the more sensitive the brain becomes to the emotional content in the stimuli.
high emotional intelligence is associated with a more efficient processing of emotional facial expressions.
